description: This script scans the project's 'src' directory for files containing suspicious 'firecrawl' related patterns, indicating potential web-fetch provider boundary violations. It reports these violations either in JSON format or as plain text, depending on command-line arguments.

methods.name: collectWebFetchProviderBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Recursively scans source files to identify those containing suspicious patterns related to 'firecrawl' fetch logic, returning a list of violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that executes the violation collection and outputs results based on command-line options.
